page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_10_v3 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. It is equipped with 416 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The server features a massive memory capacity of 9496.0 GB, which translates to approximately 22.83 GB of RAM per virtual core.

For local storage, the instance includes a 410 GB SSD. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage volumes. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are bundled with this configuration, and the server does not contain any graphics processing units.

This server type is designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes it suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, massive data analytics, and enterprise resource planning systems. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent compute performance without resource contention, though the lack of integrated GPUs limits its applicability for hardware-accelerated machine learning tasks.
